entry.title: Nano Kava — the first kava nanoemulsion, ~20 nm and 100% water-dispersible
entry.summary: Nano-emulsified kava with a mean particle size of ~20 nm: 100% water-dispersible, 30 mg/mL kavalactone load, 4–5x higher absorption than conventional kava powder, and crystal clear in the finished beverage.
